procnotices.notice_text:
Specific Procurement Notice – Request for Proposals without Prequalification

 

Request for Proposal

 (Hashi Corp Vault)

(Without Prequalification)

 

Purchaser:        National Database and Registration Authority (NADRA)

Project:            Digital Economy Enhancement Project (DEEP)

Contract title: Procurement of Hashi Corp Vault.

Country:          Pakistan

Credit No.:      7514-PK

RFP No:          PK-NADRA-575918-GO-RFP 

Issued on:        October 08, 2026

 

1.        The Islamic Republic of Pakistan has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Digital Economy Enhancement Project (DEEP) and intends to apply part of the proceeds toward payments under the Procurement of Hashi Corp Vault.

2.        The National Database and Registration Authority (NADRA) now invites sealed Proposals from eligible Proposers for Procurement of Hashi Corp Vault.

        &nbs
